transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, my brain just feels like it stalls out. I work as an engineering technologist, and lately, I'll just sit there with a test report or even a simple CAD note open for an hour. I just can't decide what the next sentence should be, or even which checkbox to click. It's like I just can't think.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

I don't know if I'd call it depressed, really. I just feel... flat. Like I said, I just sit there staring at my screen. I don't really feel sad or down, just empty, I guess. It's more that I just don't have the energy or the... the drive to do anything.
Have you lost interest or enjoyment in things you usually like to do?

Yeah, I guess I have. Um, my printer for miniatures has just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure on it for months. I just haven't cared to touch it. And even things I usually do for myself, like yoga or... or going for a walk in the woods, they just feel like another task to get through instead of something I actually want to do.
Have you been feeling hopeless?

No, I wouldn't say hopeless. Um... I know things will keep moving forward, and my life isn't ruined or anything like that. It's not like I think the future is doomed. I just... I just don't have the energy to participate in it right now, I guess.
Before this started, did you have similar problems with focus or getting started on tasks when you were a child?

No, not really. I mean, I always did pretty well in school and college. Getting started on assignments or focusing on projects was never an issue for me back then. This... this feeling of just being completely stalled out, it's new.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, that's actually the main reason I came in. My brain just feels like it... stalls out. Like, I'll be sitting at work with a test report open, or even just a simple CAD note, and an hour will go by. I just sit there staring at it, and I can't even decide what the next sentence should be, or which checkbox to click. It's like I just can't process it.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or change in your life?
Yeah, I suppose it did. It's been going on since I was moved into the prototype-testing role at work. That was... about a year and a month ago.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, especially about your work?

No, not really worrying. I mean, I know I'm falling behind, but it's not like my mind is racing or I'm stressing out about making a mistake. It's more just... blank. I don't really feel anxious about the work itself, I just can't seem to do it. So, no, I wouldn't say I worry a lot.
For most of the past two weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or sad?
I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed feeling sad or down, exactly. Like I was saying with the work stuff, it's mostly just... feeling blank. I don't really feel much of anything.
How have you been sleeping lately?

My sleep is fine, I think. I haven't really noticed any changes with it. I just go to bed and wake up at my normal times. I'm getting about the same amount of sleep as I usually do, so... yeah, nothing really stands out there.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
No, not really. Um, I'm eating about the same as I usually do. I haven't noticed being any more or less hungry than normal, so... yeah, my appetite seems fine.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Well... I don't know if I'd say I want to hurt myself, but... lately, when I'm driving to work, I catch myself thinking that it would just be easier if I didn't arrive anywhere. Just... didn't exist, I guess. Sometimes the thought of just steering off the road pops into my head, and it actually scares me enough that I have to grip the steering wheel really tight, or even pull over for a minute. So... yeah, I guess I have had some thoughts like that.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... at work, people have started finishing my sentences in meetings because it just takes me so long to answer. It's like I can't get the words out fast enough. And physically... even just walking from my desk down to the test chamber, it feels like I'm moving through thick syrup. Everything just feels really heavy and slow right now.
